chunks.title: Landmark Precedents in Banking & Finance Law
chunks.content: # Landmark Precedents in Banking & Finance Law

chunks.title: Rangappa v. Sri Mohan, (2010) 11 SCC 441
chunks.content:
### Rangappa v. Sri Mohan, (2010) 11 SCC 441
**Bench & Court:** 3-Judge Bench (K.G. Balakrishnan, CJI)
**Core Holding:** Settled the scope of presumption under Section 139 NI Act. The statutory presumption extends to the existence of a legally enforceable debt. The accused can rebut the presumption by raising a probable defense on a preponderance of probabilities without entering the witness box.

chunks.title: Mardia Chemicals Ltd. v. Union of India, (2004) 4 SCC 311
chunks.content:
### Mardia Chemicals Ltd. v. Union of India, (2004) 4 SCC 311
**Bench & Court:** Supreme Court of India
**Core Holding:** Upheld the constitutional validity of the SARFAESI Act, while striking down the condition of mandatory 75% pre-deposit under Section 17 as arbitrary, reading in the requirement of fair opportunity to borrower before physical dispossession.

chunks.title: Procedural Practice Notes — Banking & SARFAESI Disputes
chunks.content: # Procedural Practice Notes — Banking & SARFAESI Disputes

chunks.title: Cheque Dishonour Timelines (§138 NI Act)
chunks.content:
### Cheque Dishonour Timelines (§138 NI Act)
1. Cheque presentation within 3 months of date.
2. Statutory demand notice dispatched within 30 days of receiving bank memo.
3. 15-day grace payment period for drawer.
4. Complaint filed before Judicial Magistrate within 30 days of expiry of 15-day grace period.

chunks.title: DRT Pre-Deposit & SARFAESI Remedies
chunks.content:
### DRT Pre-Deposit & SARFAESI Remedies
1. Section 18 SARFAESI appeal to DRAT requires mandatory minimum 25% to 50% pre-deposit of debt amount.
2. DM / CMM assistance under Section 14 for taking physical possession requires affidavit verifying compliance with Section 13(2) notice.

chunks.title: Banking, Debt Recovery & Negotiable Instruments Statutes
chunks.content: # Banking, Debt Recovery & Negotiable Instruments Statutes

chunks.title: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 (NI Act)
chunks.content:
### Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 (NI Act)
- **Section 138:** Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds in the account punishable with imprisonment up to 2 years or fine up to twice the cheque amount.
- **Section 139 (Statutory Presumption):** Rebuttable presumption that holder of a cheque received the cheque for the discharge, in whole or in part, of any debt or other liability.
- **Section 141:** Offences by companies; directors in charge of and responsible for company conduct vicariously liable.

chunks.title: SARFAESI Act, 2002
chunks.content:
### SARFAESI Act, 2002
- **Section 13(2):** 60-day demand notice issued by secured creditor to borrower upon classification of account as Non-Performing Asset (NPA).
- **Section 13(4):** Measures for enforcement of security interest (taking physical/symbolic possession, taking over management).
- **Section 17:** Application before Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT) by borrower challenging SARFAESI measures.
